jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by software development and thrive on solving real business challenges through technology, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a team, we support NNE's engineering project portfolios and build modern applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

This is a part-time position of around 2–3 days a week. You will work on real tasks from day one, with a dedicated colleague to guide you, review your code and help you grow.

How you might spend your days

As a student software developer, you’ll be:

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Structured and responsible, taking ownership of your tasks and delivering what you commit to

• Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations and cultures

• Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions

• Open to feedback and ready to learn from mistakes, with high spirits and a sense of humour

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have a basic understanding of programming in C#/.NET or Python

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

• Know the basics of relational databases and SQL

• Have used Git for version control

• Communicate well in English, written and spoken

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15 November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Maybe you’re the kind of person who loves it when everything comes together: a candidate feels well taken care of, a new colleague has everything ready for their first day, payroll is spot on, and the details in our HR systems are exactly where they should be. If that sounds satisfying to you, you might be our new People Operations Specialist.

This is a broad, hands-on HR role where you’ll work across payroll, recruitment, onboarding, and HR administration. You’ll have plenty of opportunity to take ownership, improve the way we work, and make your mark as the role develops. You’ll be part of the HR team at Evosep, reporting directly to the HR Manager, and the role is based at our HQ in Odense.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

HR Administration & Payroll

• Manage the monthly payroll process for our Danish employees in Zenegy in close collaboration with the HR Manager, including the administration of vacation, parental leave, and other employee-related changes.

• Support the administration and maintenance of our HRMS, HR-ON Staff, ensuring employee records, organizational data, salary band information, and HR metrics are accurate and up to date.

• Prepare and provide HR data and reporting to support business needs and decision-making.

• Support the HR Manager with employment documentation, including contracts, addenda, and amendments.

• Support a wide range of day-to-day HR administrative activities.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Coordinate the recruitment process through HR-ON Recruit, including job postings, candidate communication, interview coordination, and recruitment administration.

• Track and report on recruitment metrics and KPIs, using insights to continuously improve our recruitment processes and candidate experience.

Preboarding & Onboarding

• Coordinate the employee journey from signed contract through onboarding, including IT equipment, employee accounts, system access, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.

• Ensure mandatory training is completed and correctly documented in our QMS.

• Gather feedback and track relevant metrics to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

Policies & Process Improvement

• Support the development and maintenance of HR policies, guidelines, and documentation.

• Identify opportunities to continuously improve our HR processes, systems, and overall employee experience.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive can-do attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. For this particular role, we also imagine that you bring:

• Hands-on experience with payroll and day-to-day HR operations.

• A relevant degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. A bookkeeping or administrative background combined with practical HR experience is equally relevant.

• A genuine interest in supporting employees throughout their journey at Evosep.

• Strong communication skills. particularly in writing, and professional fluency in English

• Confidence working with digital tools and learning new systems. Payroll experience is essential, while Zenegy and HRIS/HRMS experience are a plus.

• Curiosity about AI and how it can make operational HR smarter and more efficient.

• Good Microsoft Office skills.

• A solid understanding of Danish employment legislation.

• A high level of discretion when working with confidential and sensitive information.

• A structured and detail-oriented way of working, even when several things are happening at once.

• A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership and improve the way we work.

• Excitement about joining a fast-growing life sciences company and helping shape a new role.

You don’t need to tick every box to apply. If this sounds like a role where you could thrive and contribute, we encourage you to apply and tell us what you would bring to the team.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supportive colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference through what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn, improve, and develop.

• The opportunity to join a rapidly growing life sciences company and contribute to solutions aimed at improving quality of life and patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible working hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• And the list goes on. Learn more about us on Evosep Careers.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We are looking for someone who can join our team in January 2027. We will conduct interviews continuously and we reserve the right to close the job advert as soon as the position has been filled, so do not hesitate to send us an application. It is important to us that we respond to all candidates who have spent time sending us an application and you will always as a minimum receive an email with a response once the hiring process is over.

Job location:

Odense M

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

If you have any questions, please contact

Camilla Bak Matthiesen

Human Resources Manager

Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is the world’s leading supplier of sustainable ice cream manufacturing equipment. With production facilities in Denmark, Turkey, and Italy, plus sales and service offices in the US and China, Gram Equipment supplies advanced industrial equipment, helping ice cream producers make many of the well-known ice cream products sold in supermarkets or the local convenience store.

At Gram Equipment, they nurture a balanced, supportive, and innovative workplace where every individual can grow and contribute. Core values of trust, respect, and dedication build a culture of collaboration and excellence.

Since Gram Equipment was acquired by FNS Capital, it has delivered strong results and continues to strengthen its global presence in the industry. The company has 600 employees and is headquartered in Kolding, Denmark.

For further information: www.gram-equipment.com

Drive international growth with a global market leader.

Are you a commercially driven Sales Manager who thrives on building relationships with major international customers and selling complex technical solutions?

We are looking for an ambitious Sales Manager to strengthen the global sales team and accelerate growth within the largest international accounts.

You must expect 90-100 days of traveling per year.

A unique opportunity to make an impact.

You will take commercial ownership of key customers and projects, develop new business opportunities, and drive complex sales processes from initial dialogue to successful execution. Collaborating closely with experienced colleagues, you will deliver high-value, customized solutions.

What makes this opportunity attractive?

• Join a global market leader and technological frontrunner.

• Interaction with prestigious international customers and advanced solutions.

• Enjoy significant commercial responsibility, autonomy, and influence.

• Become part of a professional, ambitious organization with a robust growth strategy.

Your profile

You bring a proven track record in international B2B sales of complex technical solutions, such as process lines. Experience from projects within the food industry is preferred.

Your technical insight is combined with a strong commercial drive, and excellent relationship-building skills.

You are based in Europe and able to join your colleagues in Kolding from time to time.

Ready to make your mark on a global stage?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the future of ice cream production worldwide.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Senior Research Consultant Ulla Lyngby Christensen on +45 4880 2932.

Please note that we only require your CV when you apply for the position. Your application will be treated confidentially and will not be shared without your consent.

Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 10,000 people in 48 countries. Collaborating with our clients across real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, we specialise in major programmes, programme management, cost and commercial management, net zero and digital solutions.

Job Description

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is looking for a Commissioning Manager to work on a large, complex, Data Center project in Denmark.

As Commissioning Manager, you will be responsible for managing the project Commissioning process on behalf of the Turner & Townsend Project management & Consultancy team (PM-C) on site.

This role additionally includes travel within the EU for off site factory testing & witnessing.

You’ll work closely with other business functions across projects to ensure adherence to regulatory compliance and budget requirements.

This role will require a daily, on-site presence in Denmark.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Lead Daily/ Weekly commissioning meetings, Internally, vendor and Client

• Manage, deliver and obtain approval on relevant project commissioning documents such as Test Scripts, Compliance statements etc

• Manage the receipt, review and compliance of project commissioning documentation to achieve the necessary sign off

• Managing the Commissioning Schedule

• Manage a team of Commissioning Engineers and Vendors

• Equipment Installation Oversight

• Supervise the installation of new equipment, systems, and facilities.

• Inspect and verify the correct functioning of electrical, mechanical, and environmental control systems.

• Testing and Verification: Conduct tests to ensure operational efficacy

• Prepare and deliver Commissioning reports, progress, issues log and Risks.

• Manage the close out of commissioning risks & issues with the Contractors & Vendors.

• Verify the integrity and performance of critical systems.

• Approve the finalization of the project based on successful testing.

Qualifications

• 10 years’ experience of industrial equipment and systems commissioning & Management

• Proficiency in mechanical and electrical equipment and systems,

• Familiarity with control systems for critical infrastructures.

• Experienced in Quality Control & verification.

• Familiarity with Google drive, email etc

• Must have a “team attitude”, be self-motivated and be willing to support other groups and projects when required.

• Influencing skills as well as strong communication skills allowing you to effectively interact with clients, contractors, management, and colleagues.

• An ability to manage expectations, influence change, and report/update accurately on progress drawing on you strong planning and organization skills.

Additional Information

What We Offer:

• Exciting work in an international environment.

• Independent work with challenging tasks.

• International development perspectives and training opportunities.

• Additional benefits such as fitness initiatives, discounted event and cultural highlights, as well as shopping opportunities.

• Employer-funded pension plan.

• Modern workplace in centrally located offices with good transport connections.

We are looking forward to your application!

**About The Job

**If you love storytelling, are passionate about PR and communications, and enjoy working with the media, we’d like to hear from you.

We are looking for a skilled PR & Communications Manager to join Saxo’s Global Communications team.

In this role, you will work at Group level while taking responsibility for driving our PR efforts in the Nordics, with a strong focus on Denmark. You will help strengthen Saxo’s position in the media and build awareness of Saxo as a leading choice for investors and traders who want to take control of their financial future.

We are looking for someone who is ready to grow with us as we welcome more clients to Saxo and continue to strengthen our brand and relevance among key audiences.

**Responsibilities

**

• Drive PR and support brand positioning for Saxo in the Nordics through multi-channel communications, content development, and thought leadership

• Develop and execute proactive media strategies and campaigns, with a strong focus on Denmark

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key journalists and media outlets across the Nordics

• Identify relevant stories and media opportunities that can strengthen Saxo’s visibility and position in the market

• Draft press releases, media pitches, Q&As, talking points, and thought leadership content to support product launches, campaigns and corporate announcements

• Work closely with local management and senior leaders to align communications and prepare spokespeople for media engagements

• Ensure a consistent and compelling positioning of Saxo across external communications and media engagements

• Support issues and crisis communications at Group level, including the development of statements, Q&As, and leadership briefings

You will be based at Saxo’s headquarters in Copenhagen and be part of the Global PR & Communications team. You will report to the Global Head of Communications & PR and work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the Nordic markets.

The Global PR & Communications team consists of six employees and is responsible for external and internal communications across the Group. The team works closely with colleagues across the business as well as PR agencies in local markets.

**Your profile

**We are looking for someone who combines strong communications skills with curiosity, initiative, and a good understanding of what makes a story relevant to the media.

You are energetic, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and working independently in a fast-paced international environment.

You are structured, creative, resourceful, and enjoy identifying new communications opportunities.

• You have several years of relevant experience from journalism, a newsroom, a PR agency, or a corporate communications function

• You have a strong understanding of the Danish media landscape and what drives the news agenda

• You know how to turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories for different audiences

• You are confident building relationships with journalists, senior stakeholders, and colleagues across functions

• You keep up with developments in PR, media and communications and know how to translate them into practice

• You are a native Danish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

STINE GOYA is looking for an experienced, structured and commercially minded Customer Experience & Operations Executive to manage and develop our customer service function across our international Wholesale (B2B) and E-commerce (B2C) businesses.

This is a hands-on role with Wholesale as the primary focus, ensuring efficient order management, professional customer service and strong relationships with our international wholesale partners, while maintaining a high standard of service for our e-commerce customers.

Reporting directly to the Head of Wholesale, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the E-commerce Director, you will coordinate priorities and ensure smooth daily operations. Combining a hands-on approach with strong organizational skills and commercial awareness, you will optimize workflows, identify sales opportunities from available stock and contribute to the continued development of our customer service function, including the use of AI tools to improve efficiency and streamline processes.

Main responsibilities

• Manage and coordinate daily customer service operations across Wholesale (B2B) and E-commerce (B2C), with primary responsibility for the wholesale business.

• Ensure professional, proactive and personal communication with international wholesale partners and agents, building strong, long-term customer relationships.

• Manage the wholesale order process in Spy, including customer account setup, order entry, amendments and cancellations, monitoring open orders and handling claims and after-sales support.

• Work closely with Supply Chain/Logistics, Wholesale, Production and Finance to ensure accurate order processing, monitor deliveries and resolve customer-related issues.

• Monitor stock availability and inventory levels, proactively identifying and supporting OTB (Open-to-Buy) sales opportunities in close collaboration with the Wholesale Sales team.

• Proactively manage customer expectations regarding order status, delivery schedules, product availability and potential challenges.

• Oversee e-commerce customer service operations, ensuring efficient handling of customer inquiries, orders, deliveries, returns, refunds and complaints.

• Identify and implement improvements to customer service processes, systems and cross-functional collaboration, including opportunities to leverage AI tools.

• Ensure timely and accurate uploads of product master data and assets to wholesale partners.

The ideal candidate

• Substantial experience in B2B/wholesale customer service, preferably within an international fashion or lifestyle company.

• A strong understanding of wholesale order management, delivery coordination, customer claims and after-sales processes.

• A commercial mindset and the ability to identify sales opportunities through proactive stock monitoring and close collaboration with the Wholesale Sales team.

• A good understanding of e-commerce customer service and the requirements of serving direct consumers.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate daily operations, manage multiple priorities and maintain an overview of ongoing activities.

• Strong Excel skills, including experience working with large datasets, and experience with B2B order management systems, ideally Spy.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with a professional, personal and solution-oriented approach to customers and colleagues.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with the confidence to follow up, communicate priorities and keep processes moving.

• A proactive and improvement-oriented mindset, with an interest in using new technologies, including AI, to improve customer service processes.

• Fluency in English.

Application process

Please send the following to job@stinegoya.com with “Customer Experience & Operations Executive” in the subject line:

• Your CV.

• A cover letter of no more than one A4 page outlining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

About Stine Goya

Established by Stine Goya in 2006, STINE GOYA is an independent Danish fashion label with a distinctive approach to colour, print and silhouette. Drawing inspiration from art and design, our collections feature original prints developed by our in-house team. STINE GOYA is dedicated to supporting a more ethical and inclusive industry. We believe that diversity in all forms makes the workplace richer and creates space for everyone to express their talents, individually and collectively. Qualified applicants will be considered regardless of age, ethnicity, ability, gender, gender expression, gender identity, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!

Your position 

In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.

Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.

You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.

As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.
You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.

Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.

Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.

The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences.

"We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."
– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line Management

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.

Your tasks will include:

• Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
• Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
• Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
• Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
• Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
• Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
• Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.

Your profile & qualifications 

To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
• Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
• Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
• Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
• Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
• Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
• If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

European LifeCare Group (ELCG) is strengthening its executive leadership team and is seeking an experienced, business-minded Group CFO to lead its next phase of growth and professionalisation.

ELCG is one of Europe’s leading independent providers of vaccinations and preventive healthcare services. The company operates across Denmark, the UK, the Netherlands and Sweden, providing services that directly impact people’s health and wellbeing. It is a market leader in its niche, built on a strong operational foundation and owned by Findos, a private equity investor.

With a proven track record of organic and acquisition-driven expansion, ELCG is entering a new phase focused on scalability, digitalisation and operational excellence. The Group CFO will play a central role in developing the financial platform to support these ambitions.

The role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead Group Finance and serve as a key partner to the leadership team, the Board and Findos. You will:

• Lead and further develop a professional, business-oriented finance function covering FP&A, Controlling and Finance Operations.

• Build a consistent group-wide operating model with strong governance, transparency and commercial focus.

• Drive financial planning, performance management and data-driven decision-making.

• Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and Findos, balancing long-term vision with hands-on execution.

• Support commercial development, acquisitions, integration and digital transformation initiatives across multiple markets.

• Play an active role in shaping a fast-moving, entrepreneurial organisation where speed, pragmatism and ownership are essential.

Candidate profile

We are looking for an experienced and energetic finance leader with strong analytical and commercial capabilities, ideally coming from international service, healthcare, retail-style or multi-site operations.

You thrive in both strategic and operational contexts and enjoy working close to the business, combining structure, execution power and curiosity.

Key requirements:

• At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including five years in a senior leadership role such as CFO or Finance Director.

• Experience from international, multi-entity organisations in growth or transformation environments.

• Proven ability to lead teams and create alignment between finance, operations and commercial functions across geographies.

• A strong understanding of ERP, consolidation and BI/reporting systems, with a genuine interest in digitalisation and automation.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with executive management, boards and owners.

• A master’s-level degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

• A hands-on and visible leadership style, with the confidence to work close to the details and lead by example in a growing business.

Experience working in a private equity-owned company and supporting acquisitions or post-merger integration would be an advantage.

Personal characteristics

You are energetic, structured and business-oriented, with high integrity and natural authority. You are proactive and pragmatic, and willing to get involved directly when needed.

You create clarity in complexity, inspire collaboration and balance strategic thinking with practical execution. You are a team player who communicates transparently, builds trust and thrives in a fast-moving growth environment.

Contact and application

European Search Company is assisting ELCG with this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Brian Ranvits on +45 20 48 05 48.

If you see yourself in the role, please apply using the button below. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the position will remain open until it is filled.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Molding | Where Technology, People & Business Come Together
jobs.description:
At Gram Equipment, we don’t just build machines — we help create moments of joy.

As a global leader in ice cream and frozen dessert production equipment, our technology brings smiles to millions of people around the world every day.

With roots dating back to 1901, we combine a proud heritage with innovative technology and a passion for delivering high-quality solutions to our customers worldwide.
Your Role
As Product Manager – Molding, you will take ownership of our Molding product portfolio, combining technical leadership, commercial understanding, and strong collaboration across the organization.

You will play a key role in connecting Engineering, Sales, Production, and other departments, ensuring that our products meet customer expectations while remaining competitive, reliable, and efficient.

For us, successful product management is about more than technology. It is about bringing people together, sharing knowledge, creating alignment, and ensuring that the entire value chain works toward common goals.
Key Responsibilities
Product Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead and develop the Molding engineering team.
• Drive cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing across departments.
• Create alignment on priorities, responsibilities, and product direction.
Product & Commercial Ownership

• Take ownership of the Molding product portfolio throughout its lifecycle.
• Work closely with Sales Managers and Internal Sales on quotations, customer requirements, and technical solutions.
• Balance technical performance, customer needs, cost, and commercial competitiveness.
Operational Excellence & Development

• Ensure effective collaboration across the value chain, from engineering to production, delivery, and service.
• Drive product improvements, standardization, and efficient ways of working.
• Support product roadmaps and ensure successful execution of development initiatives.Your Profile
We are looking for a technically strong and commercially minded leader who enjoys working with people and making things happen.

You bring:

• A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering or similar.
• Experience in product management, engineering, or technical leadership within industrial machinery or related industries.
• Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage people across departments.
• A commercial mindset and an understanding of how technical decisions influence customer value and business performance.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.
• Good communication skills in English.
Above all, you understand that great results are achieved through teamwork, and you know how to create the collaboration and commitment needed to succeed.
What We Offer
• A central role with real influence on product development and business performance.
• The opportunity to combine technical leadership, commercial involvement, and people management.
• A collaborative and international working environment.
• Opportunities for personal and professional development.
• Competitive salary and benefits aligned with experience.
The position is based in Kolding, with approximately 20–30 travel days per year.
Apply Now
Ready to bring technology, people, and business together?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the future of our Molding solutions.

We look forward to receiving your application!

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

The Role and Department

We are looking for an Associate Director, Technology Transfer Lead, to lead a team of Project Managers responsible for global process transfers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC organization. The scope covers biological intermediates (BI, e.g. monoclonal antibodies), chemical intermediates (CI), conjugated drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP).

You will report to the Senior Director, Head of Late-Stage Manufacturing Development Project Management, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. You will work across CMC teams and technical functions, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Supply Chain to align transfers with program strategy and supply needs.

You will combine people leadership with oversight of transfers across sites and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs). You will lead selected complex transfers, ensuring receiving-site readiness, documented handover and continuity of supply.

**Responsibilities

****Team leadership and development

**

• Lead and develop a team of Project Managers, including resource planning, recruitment, performance management and professional development

• Coach team members in transfer leadership, stakeholder management and resolving issues across sites. Set clear expectations and encourage open dialogue and shared accountability

• Work with the Senior Director to align team priorities and resources with the transfer portfolio, address capacity constraints and strengthen collaboration across the project organization

**Global Process Transfer Responsibilities

**

• Translate transfer strategies into integrated plans with clear scope, ownership, milestones, budgets and dependencies across BI, CI, DS and DP

• Lead planning with sending and receiving sites, coordinating gap assessments, process and analytical knowledge transfer, and readiness of facilities, equipment, materials and documentation

• Coordinate engineering and GMP campaigns, comparability, process validation and regulatory activities with functional leads. Establish transfer acceptance criteria and ensure documented handover to routine manufacturing

• Maintain current plans and risk assessments, manage dependencies between transfer streams, and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations. Protect supply continuity throughout the transfer

CDMO collaboration and project governance

• Represent transfer programs in internal governance forums and relevant joint project and steering committees with CDMOs, within agreed responsibilities and decision authority

• Follow up on CDMO scope, deliverables, timelines and budgets with technical leads, Quality, External Manufacturing and Procurement. Prepare governance decisions and ensure agreed actions have clear owners and follow-up.

• Strengthen consistent transfer planning and readiness reviews, share lessons learned, and improve the Project Manual and tools. Support compliance with applicable quality processes in collaboration with Quality and functional experts

**Requirements

**

• 
Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline

• 
Extensive CMC experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including technology transfer and late-stage development or commercial manufacturing of biologics

• 
Demonstrated experience leading complex transfers between manufacturing sites and CDMOs, including integrated planning, budget management, risk management and coordination across regions

• 
Sound understanding of antibody manufacturing and the interfaces between BI, CI, conjugation and DP.

• 
Experience with antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology transfers is an advantage

• 
Practical understanding of process and analytical transfer, comparability, process validation, manufacturing readiness and the associated CMC submission requirements

• 
Working knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, and experience managing CDMO relationships and project governance.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex issues, present recommendations and collaborate across functions and cultures.

**About You

**You enjoy developing people and taking responsibility for delivery. You set clear priorities, delegate effectively and remain available as a coach and sparring partner. You bring structure to complex transfers and act early when risks or competing demands arise.

You build constructive relationships with technical specialists and manufacturing partners, and challenge assumptions while maintaining trust. You connect decisions across the supply chain, exercise sound judgment and value a ONE-Team approach to delivering shared goals.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark, with international travel to Genmab locations and external manufacturing partners.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**About The Role

**At FLS, we have simplified our business and strengthened our profitability in recent years. We are now shifting our focus to accelerating profitable growth. To steer this journey, we are establishing a Corporate Growth Office that leads our strategic growth and profitability initiatives in close cooperation with our Business Lines, Group Functions and other stakeholders.

As Director, Corporate Growth Office and Strategy, you will build and run the engine that turns our strategic ambitions into owned, tracked and delivered results. You will own the portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm of the Corporate Growth Office. This spans the monthly Growth Office reviews in our Executive Leadership Team and in each Business Line performance review. You will also connect the initiative portfolio to our corporate strategy process. As deputy to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will be a trusted sparring partner to Business Line Presidents, Finance and initiative owners.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will join a small, high-calibre team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Around 80% of the role is dedicated to running the Corporate Growth Office and around 20% to corporate strategy work. The Growth Office enables, challenges and connects: our Business Lines own the delivery of their initiatives, and you will make sure it happens with pace, rigour and transparency.

**What You Gain

**This is a rare opportunity to build a Growth Office from the ground up at a pivotal moment for FLS, and to shape how a global industrial company steers its growth. You will gain:

• Close collaboration with our CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line Presidents and Business Line management teams.

• An enterprise-wide view of how FLS creates value across Business Lines, Group Functions, sales areas and our mergers and acquisitions (M&A) agenda.

• Visible impact, as your work shows directly in our results and in how we work together as one FLS.

• A broad platform for your professional development, combining growth office leadership with corporate strategy.

• The chance to help the mining industry move towards a more sustainable future.

**You will play a key role in

**_Setting up and running the Corporate Growth Office

_

• Designing and embedding the Growth Office operating model with the Head of Corporate Growth Office, including governance forums, roles and decision rights, the stage-gate process, value rules and reporting standards.

• Turning our corporate management model into a working operating rhythm, including the monthly Growth Office review in the Executive Leadership Team and the Growth Office segment of each monthly Business Line performance review.

• Building an in-house playbook and capability, so that FLS eventually runs its growth agenda with its own people, tools and routines.

_Managing the growth portfolio

_

• Owning one Group-wide view of growth workstreams and initiatives, with clear owners, milestones, value targets, risks and interdependencies.

• Running the stage-gate process from idea to realised value, including gate-readiness checks and rigour tests before key decisions.

• Keeping the pipeline healthy through quarterly re-prioritisation and backfilling of initiatives, and spotting off-track initiatives early.

_Executive governance and reporting

_

• Preparing decision-ready material for the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line leadership on value delivered against plan, value at risk, stage-gate decisions and blockers.

• Maintaining decision and action logs, driving follow-up and escalating issues that need executive attention.

• Contributing to Executive Leadership Team and Board updates and to the messages cascaded to the wider organisation.

• Deputising for the Head of Corporate Growth Office in executive forums.

_Value tracking with Finance

_

• Defining the baselines, impact categories and validation rules that make reported value credible, together with Group and Business Line Finance.

• Reconciling initiative value with forecasts, budgets and actual results every month.

• Rolling out and governing a common initiative-tracking software platform as the single source of truth.

_Partnering with Business Lines and Group Functions

_

• Acting as the Growth Office’s lead partner for selected Business Lines and Functions and challenging the ambition, pace and quality of their plans.

• Helping each Business Line establish its own Growth Office cadence in line with our common practice.

• Coordinating cross-Business Line and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting the integration of acquisitions into the growth portfolio.

_Corporate strategy

_

• Supporting the annual strategy process and preparing strategy material for the Executive Leadership Team and the Board.

• Translating strategic and financial targets into Business Line growth ambitions, key performance indicators (KPIs) and initiative portfolios.

• Leading selected strategic analyses, such as market and competitor insights, growth levers and business cases.

_Building capability and a performance culture

_

• Training initiative owners and Business Line Growth Office leads in our ways of working, methods and tools.

• Working with Communications and People & Culture on the growth narrative, success stories and recognition.

• Promoting transparency, accountability and fact-based decision-making across the organisation.

**To succeed in the role, you

**_Experience and education

_

• Have at least eight years of professional experience, including several years with a leading management consultancy, or equivalent.

• Have hands-on experience of setting up and running a transformation, growth or program management office end to end, ideally in a growth or commercial transformation and not only in a cost program.

• Have led or steered large, cross-functional initiative portfolios with direct exposure to CEOs, executive teams and boards.

• Bring experience of strategy work, such as translating strategic targets into initiatives and KPIs; experience of running a corporate strategy process or M&A integration is an advantage.

• Ideally bring experience from industrial, capital goods, mining, energy or other business-to-business companies with a strong service business.

• Hold a master’s degree in business, economics, engineering or a related field; an MBA is an advantage.

_Knowledge and skills

_

• Know the mechanics of a well-run growth office: stage gates, value tracking and validation, governance cadence, performance dialogues and tracking tools.

• Have strong financial acumen, including profit and loss logic, business cases, baselines and impact validation, and work naturally with Finance.

• Understand commercial growth levers such as pricing, sales effectiveness, aftermarket and service growth, and product and portfolio management.

• Create clear, concise and decision-ready material and storylines in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with strategic program management tools is an advantage.

• Are fluent in English; other languages are an advantage.

_Personal qualities

_

• Have the executive presence and credibility to challenge senior leaders constructively and to influence without formal authority.

• Are highly structured, rigorous and detail-oriented, while staying pragmatic and focused on what moves the needle.

• Stay resilient and composed under pressure and in ambiguity.

• Are collaborative and inclusive, with a coaching mindset and a ‘one FLS’ attitude.

• Act with integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.

• Are based in, or willing to relocate to, Copenhagen, and are able to travel when needed.

• Have a genuine interest in FLS, our customers, the mining industry and our MissionZero ambition.

Total salary range incl. variable pay: DKK 1,220,000–1,800,000 per year.

• The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

For more information about the role, please contact Anssi Poutanen, Head of Corporate Growth Office, at Anssi.Poutanen@FLSmidth.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application materials.

FLSmidth is a full flowsheet technology and service supplier to the global mining industry. We enable our customers to improve performance, lower operating costs and reduce environmental impact. MissionZero is our sustainability ambition towards zero emissions in mining by 2030. We work within fully validated Science-Based Targets, have a clear commitment to improving the sustainability performance of the global mining industry and aim to become carbon neutral in our own operations by 2030. – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Project Engineer works hands-on with manufacturing and cross-functional teams to implement product and process changes for medical devices used in ultrasound, surgical visualization, and image-guided procedures.

The role supports manufacturing across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration and loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

This is a hands-on manufacturing engineering role, working directly with operators, technicians, engineers, and SMEs on the production floor to troubleshoot issues, execute trials and first builds, collect and evaluate data, implement process changes, and verify solutions in the actual manufacturing environment

The position combines practical manufacturing engineering with three core areas: ECO/NPI implementation and manufacturing readiness; NC, INV and CAPA activities and Equipment Qualification/Process Validation.

**Job Description

****This is an onsite opportunity at our manufacturing site in Herlev, Denmark.

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Lead ECO implementation, NPI, and manufacturing change activities from production impact assessment and cut-in strategy through implementation and closure.

• Coordinate first builds and production trials, including process updates, SOP/WI changes, training, data and evidence collection, and implementation reporting.

• Work hands-on with operators and technicians on the production floor to troubleshoot manufacturing issues, implement process changes, and verify solutions.

• Own and drive NC, INV, and CAPA activities (TrackWise), including investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, implementation, effectiveness checks, and closure.

• Facilitate root cause investigations and define corrective actions together with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and relevant SMEs.

• Lead and support Equipment Qualification and Process Validation, including risk assessments, validation planning, protocol execution, documentation, and reporting.

• Support URS, IQ/OQ/PQ, equipment qualification, test method validation, revalidation, and ongoing process review, as applicable.

• Develop and improve manufacturing processes using pFMEA, Control Plans, risk management, process controls, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure manufacturing changes, investigations, equipment, and processes are appropriately documented, controlled, validated, traceable, and audit-ready.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with manufacturing engineering, ECO implementation, NPI, or sustaining engineering.

• Experience with NC, INV, CAPA, root cause analysis, and Quality System workflows.

• Experience with or strong understanding of Equipment Qualification and Process Validation.

• Knowledge of GMP, Quality Management Systems, risk management, and manufacturing process controls.

• Experience working in medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments.

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality.

**Desired Characteristics (nice to have)

**

• Hands-on experience with medical device manufacturing and manufacturing process development/improvement.

• Strong project execution and manufacturing change implementation skills.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause investigation capabilities.

• Experience with equipment qualification, process validation, and risk-based manufacturing activities.

• Structured and disciplined approach to documentation, workflows, actions, and deadlines.

• Proactive and solution-oriented with strong ownership and accountability.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.

• Ability to balance ECO/NPI, Quality System activities, validation, compliance, and production priorities

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code

• Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release

• Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

• Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

• Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems

• Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game

• Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android

• Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. You’ll help shape solutions across the game, platform integrations, and development pipeline that allow us to reliably deliver Subway Surfers to hundreds of millions of players.

**Requirements

**

• Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#

• Solid experience developing games in Unity, ideally for mobile

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns

• Experience writing native code for iOS and Android

• Experience working with version control systems such as Git

• Experience integrating client applications with backend services and APIs

• Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

• Experience with mobile build and release processes for the App Store and Google Play

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
